intro: Create markdown files in .claude/commands/ to define your own /commands for repeatable workflows. Use $ARGUMENTS to accept input after the command name.

sections.title: File Structure
sections.code:
.claude/
  commands/
    deploy.md      →  /deploy
    check.md       →  /check
    pr.md          →  /pr <context>

~/.claude/commands/  →  global commands (available everywhere)

sections.title: Basic Command — /check
sections.code:
Run the full pre-commit checklist:
1. `npm run lint` — fix any errors found
2. `npm run typecheck` — fix any type errors
3. `npm test` — confirm all tests pass
4. `git diff` — show me a summary of what changed

If any step fails, fix it before moving on.

sections.title: Command with Arguments — /pr
sections.description: $ARGUMENTS is replaced by whatever you type after the command name.
sections.code:
Create a pull request for the current branch.
Context: $ARGUMENTS

1. Run `git log main..HEAD --oneline` to see all commits
2. Run `git diff main...HEAD --stat` to see changed files
3. Write a PR title (under 70 chars) and body with summary + test plan
4. Run `gh pr create` with the title and body

items.title: /standup
items.body: Run git log --since='24 hours ago' --author="$(git config user.name)" --oneline and format as Yesterday / Today / Blockers.

items.title: /security
items.body: Get git diff main...HEAD, then check each changed file for hardcoded secrets, SQL injection, missing auth guards. Report by severity.

items.title: /release $ARGUMENTS
items.body: Check CHANGELOG, run tests, bump version in package.json to $ARGUMENTS, create git tag, show completion checklist.
